sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S. stocks are closed all day today (Fri 7/3): As the 7/4 Independence Day holiday falls on Saturday, the federal holiday is observed on Friday, with NYSE/Nasdaq closed all day. The next trading day is Monday 7/6. Almost all community price discussion revolves around "overnight Korean stocks + expectations for Monday's open." The following U.S. stock prices are all Thursday (7/2) closing values: SPY 744.07 (-0.21%), QQQ 712.53 (-1.76%), DIA 527.76 (+1.03%)—indices continue the split pattern of "Dow making new highs while Nasdaq remains under pressure"; IWM 297.54 (-0.62%).
  • South Korea's KOSPI violently rebounded today, closing up about +5.9% (3080→3263), its largest single-day gain since April. SK Hynix +5.9%~6% and Samsung +6% led the rally, while both foreign investors and retail investors were net buyers. This is the absolute core of the discussion—the memory chain staged a "face-ripping" recovery in the Asian session while U.S. stocks were closed.
  • Key narrative reversal: After several days of reviewing events, the community has broadly concluded that the recent serial plunge in KOSPI (including circuit breakers) was mainly caused by foreign/U.S. institutions selling Korean stocks, not "Korean retail bagholders." Once U.S. stocks were closed and selling pressure disappeared, KOSPI immediately rebounded, confirming the view that "U.S. institutions were the ones smashing the market."
  • Dense positive fundamentals for memory: Samsung plans to raise DRAM prices by up to 20% in Q3; Kioxia/SanDisk jointly released the world's highest-layer-count 332-layer 3D NAND (surpassing Hynix's 321 layers); there are rumors that Meta and Samsung are discussing a $7.7 billion AI chip partnership. U.S. memory stocks were still being bloodwashed on Thursday—MU 974.23 (-5.66%, intraday low 950), SNDK 1777.31 (-12.62%), WDC 538.79 (-9.97%), MRVL 248.59 (-8.70%), KLAC 235.81 (-11.54%), INTC 120.60 (-5.10%).
  • SK Hynix will list on Nasdaq on 7/10 (ticker SKHY), aiming to raise about $29.4 billion, making it the largest ADR listing in history. The SK Group chairman will travel to the U.S. to ring the bell, and the community is widely spreading rumors that Jensen Huang may attend, viewed as the next pump catalyst for the memory chain.
  • Meta becomes the target of public criticism: Zuck's comments about "renting out excess compute" triggered concerns over a capex inflection point; META closed Thursday at 582.76 (-4.93%). MSFT 390.30 (+1.54%) and AAPL 308.43 (+4.76%, a new high but exposed by UBS as seeing May China iPhone sales down -19% YoY) became safe-haven destinations; NVDA 194.51 (-1.53%) remains the most resilient.
  • Precious metals and geopolitics: Overnight gold surged then pulled back, with GLD 378.23 (+2.06%) and SLV 55.04 (+2.72%); the community is watching the 7/4 funeral of Iran's Supreme Leader and whether Israel acts over the weekend, with corn/crude oil rising on a war premium.

社区气氛：整体情绪已从周四的绝望和恐慌急剧转向谨慎的过度兴奋的看涨情绪。韩国股市的大幅反弹引发了“周一记忆V型反击”的强烈预期，但这其中夹杂着“美国机构周日晚上回来再次砸盘”和“长周末Theta吃盘”的焦虑。人们的情绪在欣喜和自嘲的怀疑之间频繁地摇摆。

恐惧/贪婪：倾向于贪婪（约60/100）。半导体连续三天暴跌后，KOSPI反弹迅速恢复了多头的信心，“逢低买入”和“周一跳空”的呼声压倒了空头；然而，清醒的声音仍然警告说，这只是一次死猫反弹。

情绪与实际市场走势：社区情绪明显领先于且比确认的美国股票价格更乐观。美国最新的真实数据仍然是周四内存股的大阳线，但业界已经将韩国股市的反弹视为周一美股复苏的“预演”，并正在庆祝。这种“隔夜国外市场决定国内情绪”的机制值得警惕：周日晚上KOSPI还有一个交易日，如果美国机构回归并恢复抛售，乐观预期可能会落空。
